## 1. Safety, Privacy & Offline Architecture
- **100% Offline Progressive Web App (PWA)**: Installs directly on Apple Mac (macOS Safari/Chrome), iPhone & iPad (iOS/iPadOS Safari Add to Home Screen), Android phones & tablets (Chrome/Edge), Windows PC, and ChromeOS. Runs completely without Wi-Fi or cellular data once cached.
- **Zero Ads & Zero Behavioral Tracking**: Contains zero third-party ad networks, zero analytics trackers, and zero in-app microtransactions during child sessions.
- **COPPA, UK Children's Code & GDPR-K Conscious Design**: Child profiles (up to 4 local profiles), star progress, and sticker reward albums live strictly inside local device storage (`localStorage`).
- **Parental Math Gate**: Protects parent dashboard controls, playtime limits, and external billing/marketplace links behind adult verification.
- **Free Interactive Demo**: Visitors can try 10 games (2 games per world across Levels 1 and 2) at `https://wonderworldkidslearning.space/demo` without creating an account.

## 3. Complete 5 Worlds & 45 Mini-Games Curriculum Directory

### World 1: Math Magic Valley (`https://wonderworldkidslearning.space/worlds/world_math`)
1. Dino Addition — Addition, Number Sense, Draggable Counters (Ages 3–10)
2. Number Safari — Counting 1–20, Visual Quantity, Animal Spotting (Ages 3–6)
3. Subtraction Bakery — Subtraction, Cupcake Equations, Visual Removal (Ages 4–8)
4. Shape Sorter Express — 2D/3D Geometry, Shape Matching, Spatial Reasoning (Ages 3–7)
5. Multiplication Blitz — Times Tables, Mental Math (Ages 7–10)
6. Fraction Pizza Party — Fractions, Halves/Thirds/Quarters, Visual Slicing (Ages 5–10)
7. Clockwork Owl — Analog & Digital Time Reading, Daily Schedules (Ages 5–9)
8. Pattern Train — Sequencing (AB/ABC/AABB), Color & Shape Logic (Ages 3–8)
9. Coin Counter Market — Money Counting, Currency Values, Making Change (Ages 6–10)
10. Greater Dragon Scales — Comparisons (>, <, =), Quantity Balancing (Ages 4–9)

### World 2: English & Phonics Jungle (`https://wonderworldkidslearning.space/worlds/world_phonics`)
11. Word Builder Bee — CVC Words, Spelling, Phonics Honeycombs (Ages 3–10)
12. Phonics Popsicle — Letter Sounds, Bubble Popping, Initial Phonemes (Ages 3–6)
13. ABC Letter Trace — Fine Motor Skills, Letter Formation, Tracing (Ages 3–5)
14. Rhyme Time Rocket — Rhyming Pairs, Phonological Awareness (Ages 4–7)
15. Sight Word Treasure Hunt — High-Frequency Sight Words, Reading Clues (Ages 4–8)
16. Vowel Voyage — Short vs Long Vowels Sorting (Ages 5–9)
17. Grammar Safari — Nouns, Verbs, Adjectives, Parts of Speech (Ages 6–10)
18. Opposite Animals — Antonyms, Big/Small & Fast/Slow Matching (Ages 3–6)
19. Sentence Builder Express — Syntax, Punctuation & Sentence Assembly (Ages 6–10)
20. Spelling Bee Match — Unscrambling & Vocabulary Expansion (Ages 6–10)

### World 3: World Geography & Cultures (`https://wonderworldkidslearning.space/worlds/world_geography`)
21. Continent Jigsaw — 7 Continents, Spatial Map Jigsaw (Ages 3–10)
22. Flag Runner — Country Flags & Pattern Recognition (Ages 5–10)
23. Landmark Builder — World Heritage Wonders: Pyramids, Eiffel Tower, Taj Mahal (Ages 5–10)
24. Capital City Quiz — Capital Cities & Interactive Tap Map (Ages 7–10)
25. Animal Habitat Map — Continental Fauna Origins (Ages 4–9)
26. Ocean Depth Explorer — 5 Oceans & Marine Zones (Ages 5–10)
27. Globe Spinner — 3D Hemispheres, Equator & Poles (Ages 4–10)
28. Climate & Dress-Up — Tropical, Polar & Desert Weather Logic (Ages 3–7)
29. World Music Tap — Traditional Global Instruments & Rhythm (Ages 4–9)
30. Compass Navigator — Cardinal Directions (N, S, E, W) (Ages 6–10)

### World 4: Animal Kingdom & Science (`https://wonderworldkidslearning.space/worlds/world_science`)
31. Animal Sound Memory — Auditory Memory & Animal Calls (Ages 3–8)
32. Food Chain Sorting — Herbivore, Carnivore & Omnivore Webs (Ages 5–10)
33. Footprint Detective — Paw & Hoof Tracking Mysteries (Ages 4–8)
34. Mama & Baby Match — Animal Offspring Names & Parent Pairing (Ages 3–6)
35. Camouflage Seek — Visual Acuity & Nature Camouflage (Ages 4–9)
36. Life Cycle Wheel — Butterfly, Frog & Plant Metamorphosis (Ages 5–10)
37. Bird Beak & Food Match — Biological Adaptation (Ages 6–10)
38. Domain Classifier — Land, Air & Water Animal Sorting (Ages 3–7)
39. Nocturnal vs Diurnal — Day vs Night Animal Habits (Ages 4–8)
40. Pet Care Clinic — Animal Empathy & Basic Care (Ages 4–8)

### World 5: Logic, Brain & Creativity (`https://wonderworldkidslearning.space/worlds/world_logic`)
41. Color & Shadow Match — Silhouette Matching & Visual Discrimination (Ages 3–6)
42. Connect the Dots — Numerical & Alphabetical Order + Fine Motor Control (Ages 4–8)
43. Pixel Art Coloring — Color by Number & Creative Digital Canvas (Ages 4–10)
44. Kids Maze Runner — Spatial Navigation & Pathfinding (Ages 4–9)
45. Memory Card Flip — Working Memory & Pair Matching (Ages 3–10)
